name: adobe-cache-cleaner
title: Adobe Cache Cleaner
description: Find and purge Adobe caches like the After Effects disk cache, media cache and Photoshop scratch files, with sizes per app.
author: dimik

commands.name: manage-adobe-caches
commands.title: Manage Adobe Caches
commands.description: See every Adobe cache with its size and purge them one by one or all at once.

commands.name: purge-adobe-caches
commands.title: Purge All Adobe Caches
commands.description: Purge every Adobe cache at once, asking first only about caches whose app is still open.

preferences.name: useTrash
preferences.title: Deletion
preferences.label: Move to Trash instead of deleting permanently
preferences.description: Off: cache files are deleted permanently and the space is freed at once. On: they go to the Trash, and the space is only freed after you empty it.

preferences.name: detectFromAdobePrefs
preferences.title: Auto-Detect
preferences.label: Read cache locations from Adobe preferences
preferences.description: Picks up custom Media Cache and After Effects Disk Cache folders you set inside the Adobe apps (from com.Adobe.Common *.plist and the After Effects Prefs.txt files).

preferences.name: customFolders
preferences.title: Extra Cache Folders
preferences.description: Semicolon-separated folders whose contents should be purged too. Use the Copy Detected Locations action to grab the paths Adobe's preferences point to. These count as unsafe while any Adobe app is open.
